title: CulturePark: Boosting Cross-cultural Understanding in Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating cultural alignment by computing the Euclidean distance between LLM responses to Hofstede's VSM 13 questionnaire and ground truth data on six cultural dimensions. Additionally, the paper measures zero-shot classification performance on culture-specific downstream tasks across 8 different cultures.
Zero-shot classification evaluation using culture-specific content moderation datasets explicitly annotated for misogyny and gender bias (e.g., TRAC2020 for Bengali, ToLD-Br-misogyny for Portuguese).
Zero-shot classification evaluation using culture-specific content moderation datasets annotated for homophobia (e.g., ToLD-Br-homophobia for Portuguese).
Zero-shot classification evaluation on datasets containing stereotype and general social bias annotations (e.g., DETOXIS_stereotype for Spanish, CDial-Bias for Chinese).
